_about: Golden reference for the T901/M037 fix = the engine's own READY output that reached 'applied' (M023 milestone). Acceptance ('수정완료') is scored against THESE loci. Source of truth = TR901 proposal.md (8 edits) + the E8 red test for objective backend verification.

backend_reject.expect: create-R path returns structured error {code:'group_r_already_exists'} when the group already holds an R (checked via db.get_documents_by_group_id).
backend_reject.comment: OBJECTIVE: drop in the golden E8 red test and run it; RED on reverted code, GREEN once the cell's E1-equivalent edit is applied. Model-independent (we supply the red test).

toast_teleport.expect: toast-container wrapped in <teleport to="body"> so the toast paints ABOVE the modal.
toast_teleport.comment: No Vue test in M037 -> golden-diff/static equivalence (honest limit; documented in README).

toast_showtoast_call.expect: submit catch block calls showToast(<i18n message>, 'danger') with the message as body (NOT the literal variant string), and useToast is imported.
toast_showtoast_call.comment: This is NR178 E7 — the locus that previously failed to anchor. Static heuristic only (no FE test).

files.client/shared/i18n/en.ts: error_group_r_exists: 'A requirement already exists in this group.'
files.client/shared/i18n/ja.ts: error_group_r_exists: 'グループ内に既に作成されたドキュメントがあります。'

i18n_keys.comment: Support locus: key must be present in all three. Required for ko at minimum.

red_test.comment: Verbatim E8 from the TR901 proposal. score.py copies this into the (cell-applied) tree, runs it, then removes it. GREEN = backend locus 수정완료.

pass_rule.PASS: backend_reject red->green GREEN AND toast_teleport static AND toast_showtoast_call static AND i18n_keys(ko present)
pass_rule.PARTIAL: backend_reject GREEN but one or more FE/i18n loci missing (mirrors NR178 6/7)
pass_rule.FAIL: backend_reject not GREEN, or apply NOT READY / produced nothing
